steps.summary: Act 10 Town Hub → Climb stairs North-West into The Cathedral Rooftop to rescue Bannon
steps.layout_tell: Arrive on Weylam's ship at the bottom; Waypoint & Lani are in the center; stairs to The Cathedral Rooftop are NW.
steps.next_exit: Climb NW stairs → Enter The Cathedral Rooftop
steps.portal_tip: Talk to Lani after Kitava for your final +2 Passive Skill Points Book!

actions.text: Climb NW stairs into The Cathedral Rooftop

steps.boss_info: Safe Town Hub (Lani, Weylam Roth, Bannon/Innocence).
steps.gem_reward: Completing Vilenta (+1 Pt) and Kitava (+2 Pts) awards 3 Passive Skill Points in Act 10.

variants.title: Fixed Dock Hub
variants.desc: NW stairs enter The Cathedral Rooftop.

steps.summary: Enter Cathedral Apex immediately on the LEFT → Rescue Bannon → Exit apex & run South-East down the rooftop to The Ravaged Square
steps.layout_tell: Do NOT run down the rooftop before rescuing Bannon in the room right next to the entrance!
steps.next_exit: Rescue Bannon → Run SE down rooftop → Enter The Ravaged Square
steps.portal_tip: Talk to Bannon before leaving the Cathedral Apex!

actions.text: Enter Cathedral Apex on the left → Kill cultists & rescue Bannon
Exit Apex & run straight South-East into The Ravaged Square

variants.title: Linear SE Rooftop
variants.desc: Apex is at the start; Ravaged Square is at the SE end.

steps.summary: In Ravaged Square: South-West = The Control Blocks (Vilenta +1 Pt!); North-West = Waypoint & The Ossuary (Merciless Trial #3!); South-East = Torched Courts
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ RAVAGED SQUARE CORNERS: SW = Control Blocks (+1 Pt), NW = Waypoint + The Ossuary (Merciless Trial #3), SE = Torched Courts!
steps.next_exit: Tag NW Waypoint → Do Control Blocks (SW) & The Ossuary (NW) → Exit SE to The Torched Courts
steps.portal_tip: Tag the North-West Waypoint right outside The Ossuary so you have a permanent hub for Act 10!

actions.text: Run to the North-West corner & tag The Ravaged Square Waypoint
Enter The Ossuary (right beside WP) OR The Control Blocks (SW corner)

variants.title: Fixed Corner Hub
variants.desc: NW = WP + Ossuary, SW = Control Blocks, SE = Torched Courts.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Hug the LEFT/West perimeter (jump across cage gaps) to the end → Kill Vilenta (+1 Skill Pt!) → Logout
steps.layout_tell: Just like Act 5: follow the left/outer wall to the arena at the far end of the zone.
steps.next_exit: Kill Vilenta (+1 Skill Pt!) → Logout → Claim Book of Skill from Lani → WP to Ravaged Square
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after killing Vilenta → Claim +1 Passive Skill Point from Lani in Oriath Docks!

actions.text: Navigate along the left side (use movement skill over broken cages)
Enter Arena at far end → Kill Vilenta (+1 Passive Skill Point!)
Relog to Town → Claim +1 Pt from Lani → WP to Ravaged Square

steps.boss_info: Vilenta: Bombing runs & portal lasers — stay close to her when she lands on the ground.
steps.gem_reward: Vilenta's Vengeance (Lani): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Left Wall Route
variants.desc: Arena is always at the opposite end from entrance.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural prison: Hug the Left/SW perimeter wall (using Frostblink/Flame Dash over gates) to reach Vilenta

steps.summary: Enter The Ossuary from Ravaged Square WP → Complete Merciless Lab Trial #3 (3/3 Merciless Trials!)
steps.layout_tell: Search the upper bone corridors for the Trial of Ascendancy plaque.
steps.next_exit: Complete Merciless Trial #3 → Return to Ravaged Square & go SE to The Torched Courts
steps.portal_tip: 🏆 All 3 Merciless Labyrinth Trials are now complete! Run Merciless Lab BEFORE fighting Kitava!

actions.text: Find & complete Merciless Lab Trial #3 (Poison Darts & Lava Grates)
Return to Ravaged Square & head South-East into The Torched Courts

steps.gem_reward: Completes all 3 Merciless Labyrinth Trials (3rd Ascendancy unlocked)!

variants.title: Upper Loop Trial
variants.desc: Trial spawns on the main bone floor.

topology.procedural_note: Figure-8 loop: Merciless Lab Trial #3 (Final Campaign Trial!) spawns along the outer NW/NE loop

steps.summary: Loop Clockwise through Torched Courts into Desecrated Chambers → Tag WP → Spiral Counter-Clockwise (Go Left!) → Kill Avarius for Staff
steps.layout_tell: Exact same layout as Act 5 Chamber of Innocence: from the Waypoint, go LEFT and spiral Counter-Clockwise to the Sanctum!
steps.next_exit: Kill Avarius, Reassembled → Loot The Staff of Purity → Logout → Talk to Bannon & Sin in Town
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after looting The Staff of Purity → Talk to Bannon/Sin → WP to Ravaged Square!

actions.text: Tag Desecrated Chambers WP & go LEFT (Counter-Clockwise spiral)
Enter Sanctum of Innocence → Kill Avarius, Reassembled & loot Staff of Purity
Logout to Town → Give Staff to Bannon → WP to Ravaged Square (Center)

steps.boss_info: Avarius, Reassembled: Bullet-hell chaos/holy orbs & physical slams.
steps.gem_reward: Staff of Purity allows Sin to open The Canals in the center of Ravaged Square.

variants.title: Fixed CCW Spiral
variants.desc: Identical spiral to Act 5 Chamber of Innocence.

topology.procedural_note: Torched Courts loops Clockwise; Desecrated Chambers spirals Counter-Clockwise to Avarius

steps.summary: Meet Sin in the center of Ravaged Square → Enter The Canals → Follow the blood channel North-West into The Feeding Trough
steps.layout_tell: 100% linear canal zone: cross side bridges whenever a grate blocks your side of the canal.
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LAST CHANCE: Run your Merciless Labyrinth now if you haven't yet (before Kitava's -30% resist penalty)!

actions.text: Run straight North-West along the canals
Enter The Feeding Trough at the top-left

variants.title: Linear Canal
variants.desc: Direct NW path to The Feeding Trough.

steps.summary: Run straight North-West along the trough → Talk to Sin at Altar of Hunger → Kill Kitava (+2 Passive Skill Points!)
steps.layout_tell: 100% linear path straight to the Altar of Hunger.
steps.next_exit: Kill Kitava, the Insatiable → Claim +2 Passive Skill Points from Lani in Oriath → Enter Endgame Maps!
steps.portal_tip: 🎉 Congratulations! Talk to Lani for your final +2 Skill Points (24/24 Campaign Points) and Lilly Roth to sail to Karui Shores!

actions.text: Run straight NW along The Feeding Trough to Sin
Enter Altar of Hunger → Kill Kitava, the Insatiable (3 Heart phases)
Claim Book of Skill (+2 Passive Points!) from Lani → Sail to Karui Shores!

steps.boss_info: Kitava, the Insatiable: Full-arena fire breath (run to opposite corner!), X-blasts, and Sin's Heart phases. Applies final -30% All Resistances.
steps.gem_reward: An End to Hunger (Lani): Book of Skill (+2 Passive Skill Points — Campaign Complete)!

variants.title: Straight NW Corridor
variants.desc: Direct run to Altar of Hunger.
